meta.text: Now the worked solution, step by step. Step one declares the catalog variable with a dev default, then overrides it per target: dev_catalog for dev, staging_catalog for staging, prod_catalog for prod. Step two configures the targets — dev uses mode: development, which prefixes names with [dev <user>] and pauses schedules, while staging and prod use mode: production. Step three attaches the prod-only settings: run_as with the service principal, an explicit workspace.host, a permissions block, and the schedule entry living only under the prod target. And step four is the release: validate with -t prod, deploy with -t prod, then run the daily_sales_etl job against prod.
